thread:
alice: Lunchbreak quick sync — what I did / blockers / today
alice: Yesterday: landed embed cache baseline on staging, perf looks ~18% p95 improvement for median workloads. Validated with toy corp prompt sets.
alice: Blocker: canary path crashes for very long prompts due to KV replay edge case, needs a tiny runtime fix (seen in staging logs).
alice: Today: pushing runtime fix + test, then smoke canary; will need one reviewer for the PR.
ben: Nice win on cache numbers. If you post the failing stacktrace I can look this afternoon.
carol: @alice pinged me earlier — I can review the PR once it's up. Heads up i have 1h lunchtime 
dan: PR ping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/457 — small patch that avoids double-replay on truncated KV.
alice: thanks @carol @dan — that's the one. Quick snippet of the guard I added:
alice: ```
if (kv_len == 0 || start_idx >= kv_len) {
  // nothing to replay, skip to avoid overflow
  continue;
}
```
emma: Is there a spec update needed for the API fallback behavior? I remember a convo about returning a soft-failure when KV replay fails vs. falling back to shorter context.
frank: I think we should return soft-failure + metric and let routing fallback handle shorter-context variant. That avoids producing unexpected content.
emma: ok can someone add a short line in the spec doc (docs/specs/kv-replay.md) about that? I can do it if nobody else has cycles.
ben: I'll add a note and a test case to the spec PR.
deploy-bot: Canary job started for runtime@staging -> group: embed-cache-canary (5 hosts). Rolling over 3 zones.
qa-bot: Running regression suite (smoke + embed correctness) against canary. ETA ~12m.
carol: Quick ask for reviewers: if you can glance at the PR for semantics, prioritize the runtime patch first, then spec followup. No UX changes.
alice: Thanks all. If canary is green I'll request a small Dedicated rollout later today. If you see any weird outputs, paste examples here and tag me. :thumbsup:
dan: One more: code-review ping for infra change that enables a new kernel selection flag — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/212 (needs eng-infra eyes)
frank: noted, I'll loop @infra team.
ben: cc @emma for test vectors — I'll add them to the PR description.
alice: OK closing this lunchtime thread — will post follow-ups if canary fails. Appreciate the quick eyes.
